purpose: Preserve detailed material source evidence and decision disposition for every A3/A4 item, without conflating evidence gaps with human choices.

material_ledger.guarantee: lossless full A3/A4 input snapshot + material item payloads

decision_items.cardinality: exactly one per known A3/A4 collection row and A3 material status item
decision_items.material_question: explicit source-bound question only; null when no genuine owner question

output_additions.pending_owner_decisions: only from explicit source-bound material_decisions[] reviewed readback; never invented
output_additions.pending_evidence_items: only targeted source readbacks, not human escalations
output_additions.material_coverage: input vs projected counts; all missing collections visible
output_additions.scope_disposition: candidate advisory, not runtime or source authority
output_additions.candidate_independent_scope_available: advisory only for independent approved definition candidates
output_additions.a6_allowed: always false until external governed admission

architecture_decision_items.source: A5 canonical ADR trigger classification plus optional source-bound material_detail
architecture_decision_items.missing_question: null and semantic_review_needed=true; never invent owner question

restrictions: No new ADR engine or store
A5Q frozen C2 >=5 pending decisions is case-specific and must not be applied universally
No runtime approval from an exact quote or source URL alone
Pending or CANDIDATO rule not implementable
Source-only candidate even if all mechanical tests pass
